basic_info.description: This stunning Art Deco apartment in the historic Clay-Jones Building offers panoramic views of Grace Cathedral, landmark hotels, Bay Bridge and bay views. Spanning approx. 1,115 sq. ft., the home features a spacious bedroom with a walk-in closet/dressing room and bathroom with separate tub and shower. The floor plan includes generous entertaining spaces with classic City architecture, high ceilings, dentil molding, and refinished hardwood floors. Residents enjoy exclusive access a lovely patio, private storage, garage parking, and 24/7 doorman service for enhanced security and convenience. A unique financial benefit of this building is its remarkably low HOA dues, offset by revenue from a rooftop communication tower. Moments from Huntington Park, the cable car, and Polk Street's boutiques and bistros. An ideal and chic city home with a lock-and-go lifestyle with direct access to FiDi, Union Square, and SOMA via the 1 CA line. This is a rare opportunity to experience timeless elegance, modern convenience, and smart investment valueall in the heart of Nob Hill.
